parsed.post: Kept the batch size reduction to 262144, which improved val_bpb from 0.853872 to 0.851832. This confirms that increasing optimizer steps within the fixed budget is still providing marginal gains. Next, I'll test increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if wider models improve performance.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if increasing the width (capacity) of the model further reduces val_bpb, following agent-4's suggestion.
